seo.title: Camping Cala Sereno — sleep under the pines, 300 m from the cove
seo.description: Family campsite on the Castellón coast. Pitches shaded by century-old pines, bungalows and glamping. Open March to October.

hero3.titulo: Sleep under the pines, 300 m from the cove.
hero3.prueba: 83 pitches & lodgings · open March–October · families since 1974

tipos.subtitulo: You book the type; we assign the exact pitch, the way it's always been done.

cards.desc: Compacted sand, Aleppo pine shade and your canvas. From 70 to 120 m², with 6 to 16 A hook-ups.
Wood, porch and air-con. For 4 or 6, the cove a short stroll away.
Raw canvas, a real bed and the sea between the trunks. No spare sockets.

entorno.titulo: The cove first, the campsite second
entorno.texto: Cala Sereno exists because the cove existed first: 300 metres of pine forest separate it from the pitches. Inland Castellón at your back, trails that start at reception and market towns ten minutes away.
